advancements.frieren.aura_obeyed.descrip: Win the weighing of the Scales of Obedience
advancements.frieren.aura_obeyed.title: Aura, Kill Yourself
advancements.frieren.first_spell.descrip: Learn your first spell from a grimoire
advancements.frieren.first_spell.title: Basic Magic
advancements.frieren.frieren_party.descr: Convince Frieren's party to travel with you
advancements.frieren.frieren_party.title: Journey's Companions
advancements.frieren.learned_demon.descr: Learn a spell of demon magic
advancements.frieren.learned_demon.title: Know Your Enemy
advancements.frieren.learned_mythic.desc: Learn one of the Demon King's Mythic spells
advancements.frieren.learned_mythic.titl: Magic of the Age of Myths
advancements.frieren.limiter_release.des: Release your limiter after concealing your mana for a long time
advancements.frieren.original_spell.desc: Have Serie create a spell just for you
advancements.frieren.quest_the_golden_la: Defeat Macht of the Golden Land
advancements.frieren.rank_first_class.de: Pass Serie's interview and become a First-Class Mage
advancements.frieren.root.description: Receive a Journey Journal and begin your life as a mage
advancements.frieren.root.title: Beyond Journey's End
advancements.frieren.slay_demon.title: They Speak, But Do Not Understand
advancements.frieren.ubel_companion.desc: Defeat Übel in a duel; she has decided she likes you
advancements.frieren.witnessed_slayer.de: Witness Frieren command Aura to kill herself
aura.frieren.phase.scales: Aura takes up the Scales of Obedience!
boss.frieren.aura.enthrall: Aura's scales tipped against %s. Their body is no longer their own.
boss.frieren.aura.obey: The scales tip toward %s. Aura is commanded to kill herself!
boss.frieren.aura.weighing: Aura raises the Scales of Obedience toward %s. Release your concealment now!
boss.frieren.demon_king.defeated: The Demon King falls. Somewhere, Himmel's party smiles.
boss.frieren.demon_king.phase2: The Black Sun rises behind the Demon King!
boss.frieren.demon_king.phase3: The Demon King stops holding back.
boss.frieren.demon_king.spawn: The Demon King looks down at you. "Another hero? How nostalgic."
boss.frieren.draht.phase2: Draht's wires fill the air around you.
boss.frieren.draht.spawn: Draht flexes his fingers. Threads glint in the air.
boss.frieren.linie.defeated: Linie falls. She never had a style of her own.
boss.frieren.linie.spawn: Linie watches you closely. "I wonder whose fighting style you copied."
boss.frieren.lugner.defeated: Lügner's last lie dies with him.
boss.frieren.lugner.spawn: Lügner smiles. "I'm not here to fight. Truly."
boss.frieren.macht.phase2: "Let me show you my Golden Land."
boss.frieren.macht.spawn: Macht inclines his head politely. "I would like to understand you. Hold still."
boss.frieren.mirror_frieren.defeated: The reflection shatters. Even a perfect copy has Frieren's weakness.
boss.frieren.mirror_frieren.guarded: Her defensive magic holds. Wait for her to attack.
boss.frieren.mirror_frieren.opening: She attacked - her defence is down!
boss.frieren.mirror_frieren.spawn: A perfect copy of Frieren steps out of the mirror.
boss.frieren.spiegel.exposed: The last replica breaks. Spiegel is exposed!
boss.frieren.spiegel.immune: Spiegel cannot be harmed while its reflections remain.
boss.frieren.spiegel.reflect: Spiegel copies a reflection of you.
commands.frieren.exam.passed: %s passed the exam and is now a %s
commands.frieren.no_data: That player has no magic data.
death.attack.frieren.curse.player: %1$s succumbed to a curse while fighting %2$s
death.attack.frieren.demon_magic.player: %1$s fell to demon magic while fighting %2$s
death.attack.frieren.spell.player: %1$s was blasted apart by magic while fighting %2$s
death.attack.frieren.zoltraak.item: %1$s was pierced by %2$s's Zoltraak cast through %3$s
death.attack.frieren.zoltraak.player: %1$s was pierced by Zoltraak while fighting %2$s
demon.frieren.plea.0: Please, I don't want to die...
demon.frieren.plea.1: Mother... I only wanted to see my mother.
demon.frieren.plea.2: Let's talk. Surely we can understand each other.
demon.frieren.plea.3: I surrender. I'll never harm a human again.
exam.frieren.already_active: You are already taking an exam.
exam.frieren.max_rank: You hold the highest rank already.
exam.frieren.not_eligible: You are not yet eligible for the %s exam:
exam.frieren.nothing_to_submit: You have nothing the examiner is waiting for.
exam.frieren.privilege: Serie's privilege: choose one Legendary spell.
exam.frieren.privilege_none: You have no privilege to claim.
exam.frieren.serie_fail: "No." Serie turns away. Train and come back.
exam.frieren.serie_pass: "Fine. You pass." Serie seems almost amused.
exam.frieren.started: Your %s exam has begun. Use the Exam Seal to check your objective.
exam.frieren.trial.chest_found: The genuine chest! Inside: your examination seal of approval.
exam.frieren.trial.leaving: You are leaving the exam circle! Go back or you fail.
exam.stage.frieren.interview.desc: Serie is waiting. Detect her true mana in the instant her concealment flickers.
exam.stage.frieren.labyrinth.desc: Spiegel hides behind replicas of you. Break every reflection, then strike while it is exposed.
exam.stage.frieren.practical.desc: Six mana constructs drift around the exam circle. Break all of them with spells; nothing else counts.
exam.stage.frieren.replica.desc: Defeat the mirror replica of Frieren. Her defence drops for a moment whenever she attacks.
exam.stage.frieren.retrieval.desc: Five chests appear. One is genuine, the rest are mimics. Open the real one. (Mimic Detection helps... mostly.)
exam.stage.frieren.stille.desc: Hit the Stille three times (melee, arrows or spells) to exhaust it. It drops to the ground for 8 seconds: use your Stille Cage on it then. It cannot be killed.
exam.stage.frieren.survival.desc: Hold the exam circle against three waves of Aura's soldiers and demons.
message.frieren.altar_hint: The altar waits for a sigil.
message.frieren.bind_broken: You looked away. Sorganeil releases its hold.
message.frieren.blessing_saved: The goddess's blessing refuses your death. You stand again.
message.frieren.bridge_nothing: There is no gap here to bridge.
message.frieren.charge_fizzled: %s fizzled: hold the cast key longer to charge it.
message.frieren.charge_full: %s is fully charged. Release to fire.
message.frieren.charge_stalled: Out of mana: %s holds at its current charge.
message.frieren.charging: Charging %s... hold the cast key, release to fire.
message.frieren.construct_magic_only: Only magic counts in the practical exam.
message.frieren.cook_nothing: You have nothing raw to cook.
message.frieren.deceived: %s was never going to let you live.
message.frieren.demon_frightened: %s feels your mana and flees in terror.
message.frieren.desk_copy_cost: Transcription needs a book, %s mana crystals and a spell you know.
message.frieren.desk_cost: Analysis needs %s mana crystals and %s mana.
message.frieren.desk_help: Hold a sealed demon grimoire to analyse it, or a known grimoire and a book to transcribe it.
message.frieren.desk_rank: Only a %s or higher can analyse demon magic.
message.frieren.desk_unknown_spell: You can only transcribe a spell you already know.
message.frieren.dominion_none: There is nothing here to rule.
message.frieren.empty_slot: No spell in this slot. Open the spellbook to assign one.
message.frieren.enthralled: Your body moves on its own...
message.frieren.fell_no_tree: Look at the trunk of a tree.
message.frieren.fell_not_living: That is not a living tree. The spell will not fell a house.
message.frieren.flight_disabled: Flight is disabled on this server.
message.frieren.flight_exhausted: Out of mana. You drift down.
message.frieren.grimoire_sealed: It is sealed. Analyse it at a Spell Research Desk.
message.frieren.growth_nothing: Nothing around you can grow any further.
message.frieren.himmel_echo.0: Himmel: "Thanks for keeping me handsome. I wanted to be remembered... mostly by one particular elf."
message.frieren.himmel_echo.1: Himmel: "Even a long journey goes by quickly with good friends. Don't walk it alone."
message.frieren.himmel_echo.2: Himmel: "You came all this way just to polish a statue? I'd have done the same."
message.frieren.himmel_echo.3: Himmel: "Don't forget to smile once in a while. It suits you."
message.frieren.limiter_release: You release your limiter. Your true mana floods out: %s. Your magic surges (+%s%% power for %s seconds).
message.frieren.limiter_witnessed: %s releases a limiter. An enormous mana floods the area.
message.frieren.mana_capped: Your mana will not grow further at this rank.
message.frieren.missing_definition: Unknown spell %s. The data pack that added it is missing.
message.frieren.no_health: You are too hurt to pay this spell's price.
message.frieren.puppets_follow: Your puppets fall in behind you.
message.frieren.puppets_none: Nothing obeys you. Cast Azeryuze on a creature first.
message.frieren.puppets_release: "Die." Your puppets obey one last time.
message.frieren.seal_idle: No exam in progress. Talk to an Association Examiner.
message.frieren.seal_objective: Objective offset: X %s, Z %s (%s blocks away)
message.frieren.seek_death: Your last death lies %s, %s blocks away.
message.frieren.seek_nothing: Your seeking magic finds nothing of interest.
message.frieren.sense_overwhelming: You feel an overwhelming mana to the %s, %s blocks away.
message.frieren.sense_through: You sense %s signature(s), and one of them is hiding its true mana.
message.frieren.smelt_nothing: You carry nothing a furnace could fire.
message.frieren.statue_inscription: "Himmel the Hero, who defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land."
message.frieren.statue_polished: Himmel's statue gleams like the day it was cast. Somewhere, he is probably smiling.
message.frieren.statue_stage.0: Green with verdigris. Nobody has polished it in a long time.
message.frieren.statue_stage.1: Weathered, but someone remembers to visit.
message.frieren.statue_stage.2: The copper shows through the patina.
message.frieren.statue_stage.3: It gleams. Himmel would have loved how handsome it looks.
message.frieren.stille_exhausted: The Stille is exhausted! Use your Stille Cage on it now (8 seconds).
message.frieren.stille_not_yours: That cage belongs to someone else's exam.
message.frieren.stille_recovered: The Stille caught its breath and took off again. Hit it three more times.
message.frieren.stille_tiring: The Stille is tiring. Hit it %s more time(s).
message.frieren.stille_too_fast: Still too lively. Hit it %s more time(s) to exhaust it, then use the cage.
message.frieren.summoned.aura: Aura the Guillotine answers the summons.
message.frieren.summoned.demon_king: The sky darkens. The Demon King has returned.
message.frieren.summoned.macht: The ground turns to gold. Macht has arrived.
message.frieren.summoned.qual: Qual the Corruptor emerges from his seal.
message.frieren.summoned.spiegel: The mirror shatters, and Spiegel steps out.
message.frieren.sweeten_nothing: You have no sour grapes (sweet berries) to sweeten.
message.frieren.true_chest_hit: It's a real chest. Hitting it won't help.
message.frieren.tunnel_nothing: Nothing here the spell can carve.
message.frieren.unknown_spell: You do not know that spell.
message.frieren.weather_no_sky: There is no sky here to clear.
npc.frieren.examiner.line.0: The Association tests every mage the same way.
npc.frieren.examiner.line.1: Your rank is earned, not bought.
npc.frieren.examiner.line.2: Speak to me when you are ready for your exam.
npc.frieren.fern.line.1: Basic attack magic is enough if you're fast.
npc.frieren.frieren.line.0: I'm collecting spells. Got any grimoires?
npc.frieren.frieren.line.1: Ten years is not very long, you know.
npc.frieren.frieren.line.2: Flowers are nice. That's the whole reason.
npc.frieren.frieren.line.3: I'll check that chest. It is definitely not a mimic.
npc.frieren.priest.heal: The Goddess's light washes over you.
npc.frieren.priest.line.0: May the Goddess watch over your journey.
npc.frieren.priest.line.1: Rest a moment. I can mend that.
npc.frieren.priest.line.2: Holy water? No, this is just water.
npc.frieren.serie.interview: Serie studies you for a long time. Then she makes up her mind.
npc.frieren.serie.line.0: Your mana is as plain as your face.
npc.frieren.serie.line.2: Magic is only what you imagine it to be.
npc.frieren.stark.line.0: I'm not scared. My hands are just cold.
npc.frieren.stark.line.1: Leave the front line to me.
npc.frieren.ubel.clingy.0: Where are we going next? Somewhere fun?
npc.frieren.ubel.clingy.1: You're interesting. I've decided to stay interested.
npc.frieren.ubel.clingy.2: If something annoys you, just point. I'll cut it.
npc.frieren.ubel.clingy.4: Hehe. You smell like mana and bad decisions. I like it.
npc.frieren.ubel.clingy.5: I copied a spell by understanding someone once. I wonder what I'd learn from you.
npc.frieren.ubel.duel_start: Oh? You want to play? Don't hold back. I won't.
npc.frieren.ubel.gift_grimoire: Übel scribbles her Reelseiden into a grimoire and presses it into your hands, along with her spare staff.
npc.frieren.ubel.gift_later: "You can't use it yet? Then get stronger. Come find me as a %s."
npc.frieren.ubel.retreat: Ugh, that hurt. I'm going to go lick my wounds. I'll find you again tomorrow.
npc.frieren.ubel.returned: Did you miss me? Of course you did.
npc.frieren.ubel.stay: Fine, I'll wait here. Don't make me wait long.
npc.frieren.ubel.taken: Sorry, I'm already following someone. They're more fun than you.
npc.frieren.ubel.wild.0: Hm? You look like you'd be fun to cut.
npc.frieren.ubel.wild.1: Don't stare. Or do; I don't mind.
npc.frieren.ubel.wild.2: Want to play? Hit me and we'll see who's sharper.
npc.frieren.ubel.wild.3: I can cut anything I can imagine being cut. Can you imagine what that means for you?
npc.frieren.ubel.yield: Ahaha! Okay, okay, you win. You're fun. I think I'll follow you around for a while.
npc.frieren.wandering_mage.line.0: I trade grimoires for mana crystals.
npc.frieren.wandering_mage.line.1: The roads are full of demons lately.
npc.frieren.wandering_mage.line.2: Someone always buys Flower Field. Always.
original.frieren.annihilation.desc: Annihilation: anything that is not a boss dies outright, and even a boss loses up to 30% of its health.
original.frieren.element.curse.desc: Curse: withers and weakens what it hits.
original.frieren.element.flame.desc: Flame: sets what it hits ablaze.
original.frieren.element.flame.ward: Flames cannot touch you while it holds.
original.frieren.element.frost.desc: Frost: slows and freezes what it hits.
original.frieren.element.holy.desc: Holy: double damage to demons and the undead.
original.frieren.element.holy.mend: Holy mending heals half again as much and washes away every curse and poison.
original.frieren.element.holy.ward: Goddess magic mends you while it holds.
original.frieren.element.storm.desc: Storm: leaps on to more foes, or strikes harder over an area.
original.frieren.element.void.desc: Void: cuts through barriers as if they were not there.
original.frieren.element.void.ward: Spells and arrows that strike you are turned back.
original.frieren.execute.desc: Kills anything with up to %s max health outright.
original.frieren.form.beam.desc: A beam of %1$s damage reaching %2$s blocks.
original.frieren.form.bind.desc: Binds every foe within %3$s blocks of where you aim for %5$s seconds and deals %1$s damage.
original.frieren.form.blast.desc: A blast of %1$s damage, %3$s blocks across, wherever you aim (up to %2$s blocks away).
original.frieren.form.mend.desc: Mends %6$s health of yourself and everyone friendly within %3$s blocks.
original.frieren.form.nova.desc: A burst of %1$s damage %3$s blocks around you that throws foes back.
original.frieren.form.volley.desc: %4$s bolts of light, %1$s damage each, that seek different foes in front of you.
original.frieren.form.ward.desc: Wraps you in a ward that absorbs %7$s damage for %5$s seconds.
original.frieren.fragile.desc: A solid hit while it is being cast can break your concentration.
original.frieren.modifier.lifesteal.desc: A quarter of the damage dealt mends you.
original.frieren.modifier.pierce.desc: Beams pass through every foe in the line.
original.frieren.modifier.silent.desc: Cast with no circle and no mana flare: demons never see it coming.
original.frieren.modifier.swift.desc: Half the cooldown, at a higher cost.
original.frieren.modifier.unwavering.des: No hit can break the incantation or charge. Costs half again as much.
original.frieren.steady.desc: Unwavering: no hit can break it.
quest.frieren.aura_kill_yourself.reward: Reward: +60 mana growth and an unidentified Legendary grimoire
quest.frieren.auras_generals.reward: Reward: +30 mana growth and an unidentified Ancient grimoire
quest.frieren.journey_begins.desc: Learn your first spell from a grimoire.
quest.frieren.journeys_end.desc: Defeat the Demon King, as Himmel's party once did.
quest.frieren.journeys_end.reward: Reward: +120 mana growth, one of the Demon King's Mythic grimoires and a Legendary one
quest.frieren.mimic_hunter.desc: Research mimics: find 3 of them, the hard way if necessary.
quest.frieren.the_golden_land.desc: Defeat Macht of the Golden Land.
quest.frieren.the_golden_land.reward: Reward: +60 mana growth and an unidentified Legendary grimoire
screen.frieren.journey.eligible: You are eligible for the next exam.
screen.frieren.spellbook.bind_hint: Click to bind the chosen spell here
screen.frieren.spellbook.hint: Choose a spell from the left page to read it. Then click a slot below the book to bind it; right-click a slot to clear it.
screen.frieren.spellbook.hint_empty: Every spell you learn is written into this book.
screen.frieren.spellbook.none: You know no spells yet. Find a grimoire and read it.
screen.frieren.spellbook.none_here: You know no spells of this school yet.
screen.frieren.spellbook.power_tooltip: Mastery multiplies this spell's damage, healing and duration by %s (up to %s). Cast it often; hitting something with it counts double.
spell.frieren.annihilation.desc: The Demon King's own magic. A five-second charge that a solid hit can shatter, then a beam that erases everything in its path: anything that is not a boss dies outright, and a boss loses a quarter of its health. Costs 400 mana.
spell.frieren.azeryuze.desc: Demon magic. Weighs your mana against a creature's; if yours is far greater, it obeys you for a while. Press the Command Puppets key (Z): look at a foe to send them all at it, at the ground to make them hold that spot, at nothing to call them to your side. Sneak and press it to release them.
spell.frieren.barrier_dome.desc: Raises a protective dome that shields allies inside from hostile magic.
spell.frieren.black_sun.desc: A black sun rises where you aim, and three rings of demonic blasts roll outward from it. Each blast kills anything with up to 300 max health.
spell.frieren.blood_blades.desc: Demon blood magic. A fan of crimson blades; each one feeds you part of the wound it opens and kills anything with up to 60 max health. Costs health.
spell.frieren.bottled_golem.desc: The guardian the Association hands to First-Class examinees. A stone golem fights at your side for a while.
spell.frieren.catastravia.desc: Fills the sky with shafts of light that rain down on an area for several seconds. Each shaft kills anything with up to 100 max health.
spell.frieren.clear_skies: The Spell to Clear the Skies
spell.frieren.clear_skies.desc: Ends rain and thunder for a while. Perfect weather for a journey.
spell.frieren.clothes_cleaning.desc: Mends the durability of your worn equipment. A housekeeping spell with surprising value.
spell.frieren.cooking_magic: The Spell to Cook a Meal
spell.frieren.cooking_magic.desc: Cooks the raw food you are carrying. Heiter would have approved.
spell.frieren.curse_purification.desc: Cleanses curses, enthrallment and harmful effects from you and nearby allies.
spell.frieren.defensive_magic.desc: Toggle a personal barrier. Absorbs spell damage efficiently and blocks melee partially, draining mana while up.
spell.frieren.diagolze.desc: Forbidden. Curses a target into gold. Anything with up to 200 max health dies a golden statue; bosses are only gilded for a moment.
spell.frieren.dominion.desc: The Demon King's command. Every monster within 24 blocks that is not a boss obeys you for a minute, no weighing required. Command them with the Command Puppets key.
spell.frieren.earth_spikes.desc: The ground erupts in a line before you, battering and launching everything on it.
spell.frieren.feather_fall: The Spell to Fall Like a Feather
spell.frieren.feather_fall.desc: You and your companions drift down gently for half a minute.
spell.frieren.fern_zoltraak.desc: Not one Zoltraak but a storm of them. Hold the cast key: a ring of circles opens around you and fires ever faster, until your mana or your target runs out.
spell.frieren.field_blessing: The Spell to Bless the Fields
spell.frieren.field_blessing.desc: Crops, saplings and berry bushes around you grow as if a season had passed.
spell.frieren.fish_breath: The Spell to Breathe Like a Fish
spell.frieren.fish_breath.desc: You and your companions can breathe underwater for three minutes.
spell.frieren.flame_ward: The Spell to Ward Off Flames
spell.frieren.flame_ward.desc: Fire and lava cannot burn you or your companions for a minute and a half.
spell.frieren.flamme_deception.desc: Flamme's teaching: hide your mana so completely that demons look straight through you. For 30 seconds no demon can target you, and your magic hits demons two and a half times as hard. Your first hit ends the deception a moment later.
spell.frieren.flight_magic.desc: Toggle flight. Drains mana every second; you will float down safely when it runs out.
spell.frieren.flower_field.desc: Makes a field of flowers bloom around you. Useless in combat. Absolutely essential.
spell.frieren.frieren_analysis.desc: Decades of study condensed into a single look. Shatters the barrier of the creature you look at, strips its protective magic and leaves it exposed: all spell damage against it is 40% higher for 10 seconds.
spell.frieren.frieren_zoltraak.desc: The Slayer's Zoltraak, refined over a thousand years of killing demons. Charged: hold to pour mana in, release to fire. A piercing beam that few barriers stop and that hits demons half again as hard; at full charge it kills anything with up to 300 max health.
spell.frieren.frost_lance.desc: Lawine-style ice magic: a fan of ice shards that chill and slow what they strike.
spell.frieren.gathering_magic.desc: Pulls nearby dropped items and experience toward you.
spell.frieren.goddess_healing.desc: Priestly magic that heals the ally you look at, or yourself.
spell.frieren.goddess_sanctuary.desc: A circle of holy light that heals allies standing in it and puts out flames.
spell.frieren.grape_sweetening: The Spell to Turn Sour Grapes Sweet
spell.frieren.grape_sweetening.desc: Utterly useless and absolutely delightful: sweet berries become Sweet Grapes.
spell.frieren.harvest_magic.desc: Every ripe crop around you is harvested and replanted on the spot.
spell.frieren.heiter_miracle.desc: A long prayer, and the goddess answers: everyone friendly within 8 blocks is healed completely and cleansed of every curse, and blessed for a minute: the next blow that would kill them leaves them standing at half health.
spell.frieren.judradjim.desc: Calls a lightning strike onto the point you are looking at, shocking all nearby.
spell.frieren.lands_doppelganger.desc: Leaves a mana decoy behind that draws enemy attention while you slip away.
spell.frieren.light_bridge: The Spell to Lay a Bridge of Light
spell.frieren.light_bridge.desc: A level walkway of solid light runs out from under your feet. It fades after a minute.
spell.frieren.light_orb.desc: Conjures a floating light where you look. It fades after a few minutes.
spell.frieren.mana_release.desc: Drop all restraint: half your remaining mana explodes outward. The more you have, the bigger the blast.
spell.frieren.mimic_detection.desc: Reveals nearby mimics disguised as chests. Has a small chance of being wrong.
spell.frieren.night_sight: The Spell to See in the Dark
spell.frieren.night_sight.desc: You and your companions see in the dark for five minutes.
spell.frieren.ore_finding: The Spell to Find Glittering Stones
spell.frieren.ore_finding.desc: Feels the ores hidden around you and tells you how many there are and where the nearest of each lies.
spell.frieren.pocket_space: The Spell to Open a Pocket of Space
spell.frieren.pocket_space.desc: Reach into your ender chest from anywhere.
spell.frieren.qual_zoltraak.desc: The original demon version: a heavier beam that tears through barriers and pierces a target. Kills anything with up to 150 max health outright.
spell.frieren.reelseiden.desc: A close-range slashing spell that cleaves through barriers in a wide arc.
spell.frieren.reflection_barrier.desc: For a few seconds, projectiles and spells that strike you are turned back at their source.
spell.frieren.return_home.desc: A long incantation that carries you to your bed, or to the world's spawn if you have none.
spell.frieren.rust_removal.desc: Strips oxidation from copper blocks in front of you. Statues everywhere thank you.
spell.frieren.seeking_magic.desc: Points toward your last death, or else the nearest unopened treasure chest (or something pretending to be one).
spell.frieren.smelting_magic.desc: Fires the raw metal, sand, stone, clay and logs you carry as a furnace would.
spell.frieren.sorganeil.desc: Whatever you hold in your gaze cannot move. Keep casting and keep looking; look away and it is free.
spell.frieren.sovereign_ward.desc: For 15 seconds you take a fifth of all damage, cannot be knocked back, and half of every melee blow returns to whoever struck it. Cannot be interrupted.
spell.frieren.swift_hands.desc: Your hands move twice as fast for a while. Mining has never been so pleasant.
spell.frieren.tree_felling: The Spell to Fell a Tree
spell.frieren.tree_felling.desc: Look at a living tree and it comes down in one stroke, every log at once. Log cabins are spared.
spell.frieren.tunnel_carving: The Spell to Carve a Tunnel
spell.frieren.tunnel_carving.desc: Opens a 3x3 passage the way you face, up and down included. Stone drops as if mined.
spell.frieren.ubel_reelseiden.desc: Übel's own cutting magic, taught by Übel herself: if she can imagine it cut, it is cut. A wide, long arc that goes through armour, shields and barriers alike, and kills anything with up to 80 max health.
spell.frieren.vollzanbel.desc: Breathes a cone of hellfire that sets everything in front of you ablaze.
spell.frieren.waldgose.desc: Summons a cutting whirlwind at a distance that drags in and shreds enemies.
spell.frieren.water_whip.desc: A lash of water sweeps the area in front of you, knocking foes back and dousing flames.
spell.frieren.wind_step.desc: A gust carries you forward and softens your landing.
spell.frieren.wire_snare.desc: Demon thread magic. Invisible wires lash out from a point and bind every enemy around it, slicing apart anything with up to 60 max health.
spell.frieren.zoltraak.desc: Fires a piercing beam of killing magic. Once a demon's spell; now the most studied spell on the continent.
spell.frieren.zoltraak_barrage.desc: Hold to loose a stream of Zoltraak bolts. Each pulse costs mana while the key is held.
spell.frieren.zoltraak_full_power.desc: Ordinary offensive magic, poured into without restraint. Charged: hold the cast key to pour mana in and release to fire a beam that pierces everything in its path; released at full charge it kills anything with up to 200 max health.
tooltip.frieren.artifact_hint: Works while in your hotbar or offhand.
tooltip.frieren.concealment_charm.effect: Concealment hides 15% more mana and trains twice as fast
tooltip.frieren.demon_horn: Still warm. Demons are never as harmless as they sound.
tooltip.frieren.demon_kings_blade: Forged before humanity had a word for magic.
tooltip.frieren.demonic_mana_core: The condensed mana of a slain demon.
tooltip.frieren.exam_seal: Use to see your current exam objective.
tooltip.frieren.grimoire_sealed: Sealed. Analyse it at a Spell Research Desk.
tooltip.frieren.grimoire_unidentified: Unidentified. Read it to discover its spell.
tooltip.frieren.guillotine_blade: Aura's weapon. The scales are gone, but the edge remains.
tooltip.frieren.heiter_flask: Never empties itself, and never quite sobers you up.
tooltip.frieren.heros_sword: Himmel never pulled the real one from its stone. He saved the world with this anyway.
tooltip.frieren.journey_journal: Use to open your journey: rank, mana and quests.
tooltip.frieren.mage_attire: Mage's Attire: each piece adds max mana and regeneration.
tooltip.frieren.mana_crystal: Crystallised mana. Fuel for research and transcription.
tooltip.frieren.mirror_lotus_ring: A ring said to mean eternal love. Polished, not appraised.
tooltip.frieren.scale_of_obedience: It weighs mana and never lies, which is more than its owner could say.
tooltip.frieren.sealed_exam_grimoire: The exam objective. Return it to an examiner unopened.
tooltip.frieren.sigil_demon_king: Summons the Demon King. Himmel's party needed all four of them.
tooltip.frieren.sigil_macht: Summons Macht of the Golden Land, Sage of Destruction.
tooltip.frieren.sigil_spiegel: Summons Spiegel, the mirror of the labyrinth.
tooltip.frieren.staff_apprentice: A spellcasting focus. Hold it in either hand while casting.
tooltip.frieren.staff_guillotine: A spellcasting focus. Hold it in either hand while casting.
tooltip.frieren.staff_mage: A spellcasting focus. Hold it in either hand while casting.
tooltip.frieren.staff_sage: A spellcasting focus. Hold it in either hand while casting.
tooltip.frieren.staff_ubel: Übel's spare: a black spear-staff with twin blades. "It's sharp. That's the point."
tooltip.frieren.stille_cage: Empty. Hit a Stille three times to exhaust it, then use this on it while it rests.
tooltip.frieren.sweet_grapes: Formerly sour. Frieren insists this is the most important spell she knows.
tooltip.frieren.warriors_axe: Eisen's kind of axe. Stark swears he's scared every time he swings it.
